findings.summary: IKE version could not be established.

findings.impact: Past session keys do not expose rekeyed traffic.

findings.recommendation: Use endpoint runtime evidence for verification.

findings.technical_explanation: Packet sequence values do not prove receiver enforcement.
findings.title: Replay protection unassessed

findings.impact: An observer may infer application behavior.
findings.recommendation: Use padding or traffic-flow confidentiality where the threat model requires it.
findings.summary: ESP conceals payload but exposes timing, sizes, direction, and duration.
findings.technical_explanation: Traffic analysis can use these observable properties without decryption.
findings.title: Encrypted metadata remains visible

findings.impact: Payload confidentiality does not eliminate traffic-analysis exposure.
findings.recommendation: Treat low confidence and controlled-testbed scope explicitly.
findings.summary: The prototype model inferred an application class without decryption.
findings.technical_explanation: Inference uses only ESP timing, length, and direction features.
findings.title: Traffic type inferred from encrypted metadata

limitations.description: Tunnel/transport mode, SA lifetime, and replay enforcement may not be passively determinable.
ESP rekey alone does not establish CHILD-SA PFS.
Traffic confidence is raw, uncalibrated, and based on a controlled synthetic testbed.

pfs.explanation: Controlled strongSwan/XFRM CHILD-SA rekey evidence was supplied.
